raw_response:
This plot is only a small piece of my land, just over half a hectare, and it is not my main cereal plot. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, but one full bag of DAP is a lot for this size — I will put a little, maybe half a bag spread here, because the cooperative sometimes gives on credit. I keep cattle so I carry manure from the kraal onto this plot before ploughing, that is free and my father always did it. I will use my own seed I saved, no pesticide, no irrigation — rain is what I have — and my wife and older son help me with the weeding so I do not need to hire much, maybe a few days at weeding time when the grass is heavy.
